expectedIssues: Profile is highlighted in the bottom nav bar while the home feed is shown
reportedIssues: The bottom navigation highlights 'Profile' as the active tab, but the screen displayed is the Home/discovery feed (address, search, promo banner, restaurant lists).
The third card in 'Fastest near you' shows a hard-clipped title ('Trattoria Piccol') and clipped delivery text with no ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar; its name, rating and metadata are not visible and the image is sliced mid-card.
The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: white circular background on the ramen card, dark/translucent background on the pizza card.
Image treatment is inconsistent in the 'Fastest near you' row — the first card has a light gray background while the others use dark vignetted photos, making the row look unfinished.
The category chip row is clipped at the right edge with only a sliver of the next chip visible and no fade or arrow affordance.
Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart favorite buttons) have no visible text labels, and accessible names cannot be inferred visually.
